title: approval.expired
description: TTL passed with no decision (event-catalog.md §7.1). Emitted by core/approvals.py::expire_stale(). `action_taken` distinguishes the two branches §7.1 defines: 'cancelled' (terminal — the approval's status moved to 'expired') vs. 'escalated' (the approval is UNCHANGED, still 'pending' and still fully approvable/rejectable — this is a one-time notification signal only, per action_type's `on_expiry` policy in config/thresholds.yaml). Consumed by the ops notifier (digest — orchestrator/schedules.py, not built; M1.3 emits the event but does not build a recurring notifier for it).
